scripts.build:cf: set -a; [ -f .env.production ] && . ./.env.production; set +a; npm run check:env && npx @cloudflare/next-on-pages
scripts.deploy: npm run build:cf && wrangler pages deploy
scripts.check:env:
node -e "if(!process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL){console.error('
  NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is not set.
'+'  Local: put it in frontend/.env.local (or .env.production).
'+'  CI:    set the NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL repository variable.
');process.exit(1)}else{console.log('NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL =',process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL)}"
